name: io.github.kiycoh/silica-core
title: Silica Core
description: Retrieval over the folder the session opened: files, search, read, code_pack, write_note.

runtimeArguments.name: --from
runtimeArguments.description: The server lives behind the [mcp] extra, the local model behind [dense]; without them the install carries the CLI and no server.

packageArguments.description: Serve files, search, read, code_pack and write_note over stdio.

packageArguments.name: --retrieval
packageArguments.description: A static model in the server process, index and vectors built in the background at start; search is lexical until they land. `lexical` is the light server.

environmentVariables.name: SILICA_VAULT
environmentVariables.description: Folder to index and serve. Unset means the directory the client launched the server in.
